# netbox_token (Data Source)

Retrieves a single token from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_token" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "token_id" {
  value = data.netbox_token.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the token.
- `key` (String, Sensitive) The key of the token.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the token.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the token.
- `description` (String) A description of the token.
- `enabled` (Boolean) The enabled of the token.
- `expires` (String) The expires of the token.
- `last_used` (String) The last used of the token.
- `pepper_id` (Number) The pepper id of the token.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The token of the token.
- `version` (Number) The version of the token.
- `write_enabled` (Boolean) The write enabled of the token.
